summary: Live-verified both root-cause fixes in this round: (BUG 1) false-positive 'Approve button didn't load' banner suppression, and (BUG 2) frequency_penalty=0.4 addition across all 4 LLM call sites. Also spot-checked Turn-Completion Contract regression. All fixes look correct and behave as expected in preview.

issues: ~30+ HTTP 404 console errors on load (see network — likely a poll endpoint or missing asset). Pre-existing, unrelated to this round's fixes, but noisy for debugging. Worth a separate cleanup pass.

critical_code_review_comments: BUG 1 fix (frontend defense-in-depth) in MessageBubble.jsx detectShipCtaFallback() is correct: `realHasFence` now = fence present AND fence contains at least one mutation verb (uses the same MUTATION_VERBS regex shared with Gate 5 of extractHandoffBrief). A stray non-actionable fence no longer triggers the false banner. Analytics trackShipRenderFailed() only fires when hasFence=realHasFence, so telemetry stays clean too.

BUG 1 fix (backend prompt) in orchestrator.py:943-956 explicitly instructs the model to NOT emit the aurem-handoff fence for no-op conclusions ('already correct', 'passes review as-is', etc). Live-verified: model emits plain-prose 'No changes needed.' with zero fences.

BUG 2 fix: frequency_penalty=0.4 (env-overridable via LLM_FREQUENCY_PENALTY) confirmed present at all 4 real LLM HTTP call construction sites: openrouter_client.py:190, openrouter_providers.py:352 & :409, groq_client.py:132. As main agent flagged, this is probabilistic — spot-checking coherence on a normal chat turn showed no quality degradation.

Regression sanity: turn_state / continue_available / failure_mode fields still emitted in orchestrator.py done payloads (lines 2747, 2789, 3043, 3077). No spurious partial/failure UI banners in live smoke test.
Dashboard 404 noise (30+ per session load) is unrelated to this round but worth a separate investigation — flooding the console makes real errors harder to spot.

(2) LLM text repetition/degeneration — added frequency_penalty=0.4 to all 4 real LLM HTTP call sites; spot-check on live chat showed normal coherence. Frontend unit tests: 6/6 pass in MessageBubble.k1_ship_fallback.test.jsx. Turn-Completion Contract (turn_state/continue_available/failure_mode SSE fields) still emitted correctly — verified via grep of orchestrator.py.
